source: 外研社选择性必修四 Unit 3 同主题完形(初游敦煌/壁画的制作与保护/丝路驼商/鸣沙山月牙泉/义务讲解员/传播中国文化)。用词限本单元及常见词,每空唯一,选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: My First Visit to Dunhuang
passages.text: Last summer my family travelled to Dunhuang, a city on the edge of the (1)____. I had read about its caves, but seeing them was even better than I had (2)____. Our guide led us through the dark grottoes and asked us to look (3)____ at the painted ceilings. The colours were so bright that I could hardly (4)____ they were a thousand years old. In one cave we saw the famous Flying Apsaras, who seemed to (5)____ across the sky. The guide explained that Dunhuang had once been an important (6)____ on the Silk Road. Because so many traders passed through, the city grew (7)____ and full of art from many lands. Before we left, I bought a small (8)____ of a dancing Apsara to take home. That day I learned that history can be (9)____ as well as beautiful. I will never (10)____ my first visit to the desert city.

questions.explanation: 敦煌位于沙漠边缘,后文又称 desert city → desert。
better than I had imagined 比想象的还好 → imagined。
look up at the ceilings 抬头看天花板 → up。
could hardly believe 难以相信 → believe。
seemed to float across the sky 仿佛在天空飘浮 → float。
an important stop on the Silk Road 丝路上重要的一站 → stop。
the city grew rich 城市变得富裕 → rich。
a small picture of a dancing Apsara 一张飞天小画 → picture。
history can be exciting 历史可以很精彩 → exciting。
never forget my first visit 永远不会忘记 → forget。

passages.title: How the Murals Were Made
passages.text: The murals of Dunhuang were not painted in a single day. First, workers had to (1)____ the rough rock walls until they were smooth. Then artists drew the main lines (2)____ a thin brush. They made their own colours from stones and plants, (3)____ some of these colours have lasted for over a thousand years. The work was slow and difficult, (4)____ the artists were very patient. Today these ancient paintings are extremely (5)____, so the people who look after them must be careful. Bright light can make the colours (6)____, and damp air can harm the walls. For this (7)____, only a small number of visitors may enter each cave every day. Experts also use cameras to make digital (8)____ of every wall. In this way, students can (9)____ the art on a screen without harming the real caves. Thanks to their hard work, the murals will be kept (10)____ for many years to come.

questions.explanation: clean the rough rock walls 清理粗糙的岩壁 → clean。
draw lines with a brush 用刷子画线 → with。
前因后果:so some colours have lasted → so。
工作艰难“但”画师有耐心,转折 → but。
extremely fragile 极其脆弱 → fragile。
light can make the colours fade 使颜色褪去 → fade。
For this reason 因此 → reason。
digital copies of every wall 每面墙的数字副本 → copies。
students can study the art 学生可以研究艺术 → study。
kept safe for many years 妥善保存许多年 → safe。

passages.title: A Trader on the Silk Road
passages.text: My name is Anir, and for many years I have been a trader on the Silk (1)____. Each spring I load my camels with silk and tea and begin the long (2)____ west. The desert is hard and dry, so I always carry plenty of (3)____ with me. (4)____ I reach the oasis of Dunhuang, I feel safe at last. There I can rest, feed my animals, and (5)____ my goods for spices and glass from the West. The market is always (6)____ with people from many different lands. In the evenings, traders share stories around the fire, and I have learned a few (7)____ of several languages. Dunhuang is more than a place to do (8)____; it is where East and West truly meet. (9)____ the journey is dangerous, I would not give it up. Every time I see the green trees of the oasis (10)____ of me, I know that all the hard miles were worth it.

questions.explanation: the Silk Road 丝绸之路 → Road。
the long journey west 漫长的西行 → journey。
干旱沙漠中携带充足的水 → water。
到达绿洲“时”感到安全,时间关系 → When。
exchange my goods for spices 拿货物换香料 → exchange。
the market is always busy 集市总是热闹 → busy。
a few words of several languages 几种语言的几个词 → words。
a place to do business 做生意的地方 → business。
旅程危险“尽管”如此也不放弃,让步 → Although。
the oasis ahead of me 前方的绿洲 → ahead。

passages.title: Mingsha Mountain and Crescent Lake
passages.text: Just outside Dunhuang there is a famous (1)____ called Mingsha Mountain, made entirely of soft yellow sand. Many visitors climb to the top to watch the (2)____ go down over the desert. The view from up there is so beautiful that people fall (3)____ love with it at once. At the foot of the mountain lies Crescent Lake, a small pool of clear water (4)____ has never dried up, even in the hot desert. Local people say the lake is shaped (5)____ a new moon. In the early morning, before the day grows too (6)____, you can ride a camel across the sand. The animals walk slowly and steadily, (7)____ you feel quite safe on their backs. Some travellers stay until night (8)____, just to see the bright stars above the quiet dunes. (9)____ you ever go to Dunhuang, do not miss this magical place. It is a part of the desert (10)____ you will remember for the rest of your life.

questions.explanation: 沙堆成的山,a famous hill → hill。
watch the sun go down 看落日 → sun。
fall in love with 爱上 → in。
先行词 water、从句缺主语 → that。
shaped like a new moon 形如新月 → like。
沙漠白天太热,before the day grows too hot → hot。
走得平稳,“所以”你很安全,结果 → so。
stay until night falls 待到夜幕降临 → falls。
如果你去敦煌,别错过此地,条件 → If。
先行词 part、从句缺宾语 → that。

passages.title: My Grandmother the Guide
passages.text: My grandmother has been a volunteer (1)____ at the Mogao Grottoes for over twenty years. Every weekend she leads small groups of visitors through the dark caves and tells them the old (2)____ behind each painting. She always speaks softly, (3)____ loud voices and bright lights can harm the fragile murals. People come from all over the world, (4)____ many of them do not speak Chinese. To help them, my grandmother has learned to explain things in simple (5)____. She loves her work because it lets her (6)____ the beauty of Dunhuang with others. (7)____ a tour ends, the visitors often thank her warmly. Last month a foreign student told her that the caves were the most (8)____ thing he had ever seen. My grandmother smiled and said that was the best (9)____ she could ever receive. She hopes that more young people will come to (10)____ the great art of their own country.

questions.explanation: a volunteer guide 义务讲解员 → guide。
the old stories behind each painting 每幅画背后的故事 → stories。
轻声说话“因为”大声会损害壁画,原因 → because。
世界各地的人,“但”很多不说中文,转折 → but。
explain things in simple words 用简单的话解释 → words。
share the beauty with others 与人分享美 → share。
参观结束“时”游客道谢,时间 → When。
the most wonderful thing 最美妙的东西 → wonderful。
the best gift she could receive 最好的礼物 → gift。
appreciate the great art 欣赏伟大的艺术 → appreciate。

passages.title: Sharing Chinese Culture
passages.text: More and more people around the world want to learn about Chinese (1)____. To help them, China has opened many Confucius Institutes abroad. These institutes teach the Chinese (2)____ and also hold art shows, talks and film festivals. (3)____ a student joins, he or she can learn not only the words but also the ideas behind them. Many learners say that studying the language helps them (4)____ Chinese culture far more deeply. (5)____ the lessons are sometimes difficult, the students rarely give up. One teacher told me that his happiest (6)____ was watching shy learners grow confident. (7)____ he teaches Chinese, he feels that he is building a small bridge between two (8)____. Cultural exchange, he says, should travel in both (9)____, so that each side can learn from the other. (10)____ such work continues, friendship between nations will surely grow stronger year by year.

questions.explanation: learn about Chinese culture 了解中国文化 → culture。
teach the Chinese language 教汉语 → language。
学生加入“时”能学到思想,时间 → When。
helps them understand Chinese culture 帮助理解中国文化 → understand。
课程虽难,学生很少放弃,让步 → Although。
his happiest moment 他最快乐的时刻 → moment。
“因为”教汉语,他觉得在架桥,原因 → Because。
a bridge between two cultures 两种文化间的桥 → cultures。
travel in both directions 双向流动 → directions。
“只要”工作继续,友谊就会更牢,条件 → As long as。
